descriptionCh: 清揚奔放的輕發酵茶，茶香輕逸，入喉甜醇，讓人著迷的飽滿香氣。
descriptionEn: A vibrant and uplifting lightly fermented tea with an airy floral aroma and a sweet, mellow finish, boasting a captivating, full-bodied fragrance.

descriptionCh: 精選綠茶高品質茶葉，清爽的味道中帶著一絲清雅的茉莉花香，一口飲下，清甜爽口滋味絕佳。
descriptionEn: Selected premium green tea leaves infused with delicate notes of elegant jasmine. Refreshing, crisp, and pleasantly sweet with every sip.

descriptionCh: 帶有濃烈奔氣味的烏龍茶香，沉穩優雅，深度烘焙成就它的甘醇厚實。
descriptionEn: An elegant and robust oolong tea enriched by deep roasting, delivering a bold, grounding aroma and a rich, mellow finish.

descriptionCh: 清雅香氣的濃郁紅茶，偏紅茶色透著清亮光澤，多層次的甘甜，入口餘韻芳醇。
descriptionEn: A rich Ceylon black tea with an elegant aroma and bright amber glow, featuring multi-layered sweetness and a lingering, aromatic aftertaste.

descriptionCh: 以高品質茶湯為底，淋上加入獨家祕方與鮮奶調製而成的濃郁鹹甜奶蓋，以品奶、品茶、品奶茶三部曲品嚐，經典滋味，多重享受！
descriptionEn: Brewed premium tea topped with Gong cha’s signature savory-sweet milk foam made with fresh milk. Savor it in three steps—foam first, tea second, then blend together for the ultimate classic experience!

name_en: Milk Foam Black Tea w Oreo Crumb
descriptionCh: 獨家祕方特調濃郁鹹甜奶蓋，覆蓋上OREO巧酥，綿滑口感帶著酥脆顆粒，綠茶清新宜人，內含珍珠。
descriptionEn: Signature savory-sweet milk foam topped with crunchy Oreo crumbs and paired with refreshing tea and chewy pearls, delivering a delightful blend of silky and crispy textures.

descriptionCh: 香醇甜美的古早味冬瓜茶，懷舊的回甘滋味，舒暢身心的飲品首選
descriptionEn: A sweet and fragrant traditional winter melon drink with a nostalgic, naturally refreshing finish—the ideal comfort beverage to soothe your day.

descriptionCh: 甘甜潤口的冬瓜茶加上新鮮檸檬汁，酸甜完美融合的清爽滋味，令人回味無窮。
descriptionEn: Sweet and smooth winter melon tea infused with freshly squeezed lemon juice, creating a perfect harmony of sweet and tart flavors that leaves a lasting impression.

descriptionCh: 古早味冬瓜茶配上四季春青茶，甘美香甜又潤喉的冬瓜茶，調和輕柔回甘的淡雅茶香。
descriptionEn: Nostalgic sweet winter melon tea paired with Four Seasons Spring oolong, blending soothing sweetness with a gentle, lingering tea fragrance.

descriptionCh: 清新宜人的青茶基底，襯托出芒果的香甜， 酸甜不膩口，必點推薦。
descriptionEn: Refreshing oolong tea highlighted by luscious, tropical mango sweetness. Perfectly balanced and never overly sweet—a must-try favorite.

descriptionCh: 百香果與清新淡雅的四季春，交織出獨特酸甜滋味，口感層次豐富，香味芬芳。
descriptionEn: Vibrant passion fruit blended with light and aromatic Four Seasons Spring tea, creating an exquisitely tangy-sweet profile with rich aromatic layers.

descriptionCh: 嚴選新鮮百香果與清爽的綠茶，加上Q彈的珍珠以及爽口的椰果，滋味酸酸甜甜，口感層次豐富、嚼感十足。
descriptionEn: Fresh, zesty passion fruit infused with crisp green tea, loaded with chewy boba pearls and coconut jelly for a fun, fruity, and delightfully chewy beverage.

descriptionCh: 綠茶與酸甜養樂多交織出獨特滋味，酸甜滋潤風味令人愛不釋手。
descriptionEn: Crisp green tea meets tangy, sweet probiotic Yakult yogurt, crafting a revitalizing and irresistible sweet-tart balance.

descriptionCh: 水蜜桃清甜香氣與綠茶巧妙融合，茶香鮮明，清爽不膩。
descriptionEn: The delicate sweetness of ripe peach gracefully infused into jasmine green tea, offering a crisp, fragrant, and refreshing sip.

descriptionCh: 超人氣的酸甜葡萄風味，融合在擁有自然香氣的青茶之中，酸中帶甜清香宜人，回潤甘醇爽口不膩。
descriptionEn: Popular sweet-tart grape flavor shaken into naturally fragrant oolong tea, providing a delightfully crisp, fruity, and soothing taste.

name_en: Milk Foam Brown Sugar Oolong Tea
descriptionCh: 經深度烘焙產生沉穩濃烈的烏龍茶香，加上黑糖焦香，更凸顯烏龍茶的獨特風味，最後再加上鹹香奶蓋，相互堆疊出絕佳平衡。
descriptionEn: Deeply roasted oolong tea infused with caramelized brown sugar and crowned with savory milk foam, layering complex roasted, sweet, and creamy notes into flawless balance.

descriptionCh: 超人氣巧克力，加入鮮奶特調而成的濃郁鹹甜奶蓋，多重享受一次滿足。
descriptionEn: Rich, indulgent chocolate topped with Gong cha’s signature savory-sweet fresh milk foam, satisfying your cravings with decadent, velvety layers.

descriptionCh: 以新鮮檸檬汁為底，加入愛玉以及寒天，每一口喝起來都滿滿的寒天以及愛玉，帶有些微酸、微甜，清涼爽口。
descriptionEn: A zesty fresh lemon base paired with slippery aiyu jelly and chewy white pearls (kanten), offering an invigorating, subtly sweet and tart cooling treat.

descriptionCh: 濃濃的芒果香讓人甜進心坎裡，調勻了招牌的奶蓋一起入口，冰涼的冰沙讓人越喝越開心。
descriptionEn: An icy mango smoothie bursting with rich tropical sweetness, layered with velvety milk foam for a frosty, creamy, and uplifting indulgence.

descriptionCh: 有著豐富的甜蜜果香與Q彈的口感，以獨特清爽的青茶為基底，搭配超有咬勁的小碎冰，創造出令人著迷的夏季幸福滋味。
descriptionEn: Bursting with luscious mango sweetness and chewy popping gems over a crisp oolong base and crushed ice, capturing the ultimate refreshing summer bliss.

descriptionCh: 嚴選高品質茶葉為基底，獨家比例調製而成，奶香濃郁、茶香醇厚，經典必點！
descriptionEn: Crafted from premium Ceylon tea leaves and balanced to creamy perfection, delivering a bold tea body and smooth milky richness—an all-time classic.

descriptionCh: 晶瑩飽滿又Q嫩的珍珠與香醇濃厚的奶茶完美絕配，成就經典、風靡全球的美味！
descriptionEn: Chewy, glossy boba pearls paired seamlessly with rich and fragrant milk tea—the world-famous signature drink that defines boba culture.

descriptionCh: 香濃綿密的芋頭風味奶香，簡單而又豐馥的味覺感受，甜蜜美味領居熱銷排行。
descriptionEn: Creamy, velvety taro-infused milk tea delivering comforting sweetness and a rich, satisfying aroma that consistently tops best-seller charts.

descriptionCh: 紅茶基底奶茶，搭配滑順軟嫩的仙草凍，帶出滿口回甘的清爽感。
descriptionEn: Smooth black milk tea paired with tender, silky herbal grass jelly, imparting an authentic, refreshing sweetness with every soothing sip.

descriptionCh: 特選高品質茶湯與香醇濃郁鮮奶融合，完美比例調製而成，口感絲滑柔順，鮮醇甘厚。
descriptionEn: Premium Ceylon black tea seamlessly blended with rich fresh milk in golden proportions, offering a velvety-smooth mouthfeel and mellow sweetness.

descriptionCh: 特選高品質茶湯與香醇濃郁鮮奶融合，完美比例調製而成，口感絲滑柔順，鮮醇甘厚。
descriptionEn: Delicate jasmine green tea combined with creamy fresh milk in perfect harmony, delivering an elegant floral note and a silky, mellow finish.

descriptionCh: 特選高品質茶湯與香醇濃郁鮮奶融合，完美比例調製而成，口感絲滑柔順，鮮醇甘厚。
descriptionEn: High-mountain Four Seasons Spring tea harmonized with fresh dairy milk, creating a wonderfully silky texture with a light floral tea essence.

descriptionCh: 特選高品質茶湯與香醇濃郁鮮奶融合，完美比例調製而成，口感絲滑柔順，鮮醇甘厚。
descriptionEn: Deeply roasted oolong tea paired with luscious fresh milk, offering a smooth, grounding brew with rich roasted undertones.

descriptionCh: 晶瑩飽滿又Q嫩的珍珠與香醇濃厚的鮮奶與茶湯完美絕配，成就經典、風靡全球的美味。
descriptionEn: Fresh milk black tea latte paired with chewy, glossy boba pearls—a luxurious, creamy twist on the beloved global classic.

descriptionCh: 日式抹茶與濃純鮮奶的完美融合，滋味濃郁厚實，層次豐富令人愛不釋口！
descriptionEn: Japanese-style matcha blended with pure fresh milk, featuring rich, earthy depth and creamy sweetness that delights the palate.

descriptionCh: 濃郁甜蜜的黑糖香氣，搭配一顆顆Q彈珍珠，加入香醇紅茶拿鐵，成就出風靡全球味蕾的迷人滋味。
descriptionEn: Rich, caramelized brown sugar and chewy boba pearls enveloped in smooth black tea latte, delivering an irresistibly decadent world-favorite flavor.

name_en: Tea Latte w Caramel Pudding & Pearl
descriptionCh: 香醇濃厚的鮮奶茶放入一整顆滑嫩的布丁與飽滿的珍珠，豐富多重的享受一杯滿足!
descriptionEn: Silky fresh milk tea filled with a whole soft egg pudding and chewy pearls, offering an indulgent, multi-textured dessert in a cup.

descriptionCh: 清涼Q嫩仙草融入奶香，每一口都喝得到豐富層次，加上仙草凍的滑嫩口感，令人回味無窮。
descriptionEn: Cool, silky herbal grass jelly immersed in creamy fresh milk, providing a refreshing, delicately textured experience that lingers pleasantly.

name_en: Peach Oolong Tea w Kanten Jelly
descriptionCh: 以烏龍茶濃郁的焙茶香氣伴著圓潤的水蜜桃果香，加上具有豐富咀嚼口感的寒天，與茶湯一同帶來多重的層次風味。
descriptionEn: Robust roasted oolong tea accented by juicy, ripe peach notes and topped with delightfully chewy kanten jelly for a layered and satisfying fruit tea.
